$comment: Cloudflare Rate Limiting rules for app.spindle.app. Apply via dashboard (Security > WAF > Rate limiting rules) or the Rulesets API (http_ratelimit phase). Characteristics: period is the counting window; requests_to_count and mitigation_timeout are per rule. mitigation_timeout 0 = block for the rest of the period; use a short timeout plus counting for sliding-ish behavior. Counting expression examples use ip.src; swap to http.request.headers['cf-connecting-ip'] is implicit — ip.src is already the true client IP at the edge.

rules.description: Per-IP volumetric cap for all app.spindle.app traffic
rules.notes: 300 req / 10s per IP per colo is generous for browsers, brutal for scrapers. Colo in characteristics makes limits per-PoP; drop it for a stricter global per-IP cap at higher rule cost.
Covers sign-in, magic-link, 2FA verify/resend. App-level limiter in src/lib/rate-limit adds a second, tighter per-route window.
managed_challenge instead of block: legitimate users behind CGNAT occasionally trip this; a challenge is cheaper than a support ticket.

rules.description: Placeholder: per-API-key tier once API keys ship
rules.notes: Rate Limiting characteristics accept header values, giving a per-key bucket. When keys are authenticated, move the real limit into the app keyed on the verified key id; this rule only stops an unvalidated key header from being sprayed.

rules.description: Lab hostname: WebSocket upgrades are long-lived; cap connection churn, not traffic
rules.notes: lab.spindle.app carries notebook/terminal/dev-server WebSockets. Rate-limit rule counts HTTP requests including the upgrade handshake; 120/min per IP is far above human reconnect rates. Do NOT apply a low requests_to_count here — session reconnect storms after a deploy are legitimate.

exemptions.description: Health/ready probes must never be rate limited
exemptions.notes: Cloudflare rate limiting rules support 'Skip' action with ratelimit products. Alternatively exclude these paths from the rule expressions above. Verify the exact path the compose healthcheck hits (currently GET / on 127.0.0.1:8080, loopback-only — it never traverses the tunnel, so edge rules cannot affect it).
